name: PURIST CIRCUIT: Unaugmented Athletic Championship
description: The oldest continuously operating zero-aug league in GLMZ, the Purist Circuit runs verified unaugmented athletes through a rotating schedule of track, field, swimming, and gymnastics events under the governance of the Independent Athletic Compact, a non-corponation body funded by Tier 3-4 subscription fees. Every competitor submits to invasive chrome-scan and geneware assay before each event, and the Circuit's certification process is notoriously rigorous — producing a small, devoted athlete pool. Matches are quiet affairs compared to chrome leagues, but generate an intensely loyal subscriber base who treat human physical limits as a kind of sacred text.
story_hooks: A Purist Circuit champion from a Tier 1 background is quietly approached by a corponation talent scout offering a chrome contract that would end her eligibility — and triple her annual income.
An anti-aug political faction attempts to formally adopt the Purist Circuit as their movement's symbol, and the athletes must decide whether to publicly refuse or stay silent.
A Circuit official running the geneware assay program discovers a loophole being exploited by a well-funded Tier 4 training academy and faces pressure from sponsors to keep it quiet.
